basic_profile.bio: I'm a 25-year-old jewelry designer based in Portland, Oregon. I recently discovered Reddit and have been exploring various communities ever since. I spend my days crafting unique pieces and my evenings gaming or cuddling with my two cats. I'm currently single and enjoy meeting people who share my interests in art and gaming. I usually browse Reddit late at night, especially after midnight when I'm winding down from work.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a Bachelor's degree in Fine Arts, specializing in jewelry design. Most of my knowledge in gaming headsets and other gadgets comes from self-teaching and staying up-to-date with tech reviews and forums. My love for animals stems from growing up with pets and volunteering at local animal shelters.
